sources.title: Anthropic and OpenAI revenue growth accelerates in 2026 as combined ARR tops $115 billion

checks.explanation: Estimates of 2026 AI industry revenue vary widely by methodology (from a few hundred billion in direct product/service revenue to over $2 trillion including total AI spending), making Laffont's specific $300B-in-2026-doubling-to-2027 claim hard to confirm or deny cleanly, and the 2027 half of the prediction has not yet elapsed.
